tips.cash: Virtual money you have available to open new trades.
tips.open: How many paper positions you currently have open.
tips.realizedPnl: Total profit or loss locked in from positions you've already closed.
tips.side: Long profits when price goes up; short profits when it goes down. Futures also show the leverage used.
tips.size: How much of the coin this position holds.
tips.entry: The average price you opened this position at.
tips.current: The live market price right now — your P&L is based on this.
tips.liquidation: If price reaches this level, the position is closed automatically and its margin is lost.
tips.takeProfit: Price at which the position closes automatically to lock in profit.
tips.stopLoss: Price at which the position closes automatically to limit losses.
tips.opened: When this position was opened or last changed.
tips.margin: The cash set aside from your balance to back this futures position.
tips.positionSize: The full size of the position — your margin multiplied by the leverage.
tips.estLiquidation: Roughly where the position would be liquidated at this leverage. Higher leverage puts it closer to the entry price.
tips.profitAtTp: What you'd make if price reaches your take-profit level.
tips.lossAtSl: What you'd lose if price reaches your stop-loss level.
tips.amount: How much to trade. Tap $ to switch between a dollar amount and an amount of the coin.
tips.leverage: Multiplies your position size (and your gains and losses) relative to the margin you put in. Higher leverage means liquidation is closer.
tips.orderType: Market orders fill right away at the live price. Limit and TWAP orders are coming soon.
tips.isolated: Isolated margin: only the margin of this position is at risk if it gets liquidated, not your whole balance.
tips.spotFutures: Spot buys or sells the coin itself. Futures lets you go long or short with leverage.
tips.short: Profit if the price goes down.
tips.long: Profit if the price goes up.
tips.sell: Sell coins you hold at the live price.
tips.buy: Buy the coin at the live price.

paperTrading.levNote: Higher leverage amplifies your gains and losses, and increases your risk of liquidation.
